name: NH Foods Ltd.
summary: NH Foods Ltd. engages in manufacturing and selling ham, sausage, processed food, meat, and dairy product in Japan and internationally. The company offers ham and sausages under the SCHAU ESSEN brand; Chinese food meal kits under the Chuka Meisai brand; chilled pizza under the Ishigama Kobo brand; and other meat product under the Hokkaido Carl Ramon and Kamakura Ham Tomioka brands. It also provides dairy products, such as cheese and yogurt products. In addition it involved in the production and raising, slaughtering, processing, distribution, and sale of fresh meat products, as well as engages in the operation of a football club, baseball club, and ballpark.
